64-5232-8043.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast a spell for free using Vision this turn.
64-5232-8043.description:
Cast Clone Legion for free due to Vision, creating a token copy of each creature you control.
Put the copy of Vision whose ability has been used in your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Warden of the Eye token enters, it triggers, returning Clone Legion from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

4681-5170-6634-8249.description:
Activate Defiant Salvager by sacrificing Karmic Guide.
When Karmic Guide dies, Al Bhed Salvagers triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life
Resolve the Defiant Salvager ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Defiant Salvager
Activate Defiant Salvager by sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it and Al Bhed Salvagers trigger.
Resolve the Al Bhed Salvagers trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Karmic Guide from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Karmic Guide enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Defiant Salvager ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Defiant Salvager
Repeat.

1829-1981-2415-8250.description:
Activate Scarland Thrinax by sacrificing a creature
When the creature dies, Vindictive Vampire and Havoc Jester trigger.
Resolve the Vindictive Vampire trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and dealing 1 damage to each opponent
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve Scarland Thrinax's ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

803-6797-6871-6879.notablePrerequisites: You have an artifact creature in hand with the mana to cast it.
803-6797-6871-6879.description:
Cast any artifact creature by paying its mana cost.
When the artifact creature enters as an Ally due to Arcane Adaptation, Haru triggers, earthbending the artifact creature, as it's a land due to Toph.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing the artifact creature.
When the creature dies, Haru triggers, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When the creature enters as an Ally due to Arcane Adaptation, Haru triggers, earthbending the creature, as it's a land due to Toph.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Phantom Train and causing it to become a creature until end of turn.
Repeat from step 3.

1170-2510-8164.notablePrerequisites: There is a sorcery card exiled with Semblance Anvil.
1170-2510-8164.description:
Cast a copy of Soul Tether by paying {R/G}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Heartwood Crafter. It'll enter prepared due to its effect.
Resolve Soul Tether, creating a Heartwood token.
Activate the Heartwood by tapping it, adding {R/G}.
Repeat.

147-1854-6797.easyPrerequisites: There's a creature card in your graveyard.
147-1854-6797.description:
Cast Makeshift Mannequin by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, targeting Makeshift Mannequin.
Holding priority, activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage, putting a +1/+1 counter on Phantom Train and causing it to become a creature until end of turn.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Makeshift Mannequin
Resolve the Makeshift Mannequin copy, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

uses.n: Sephiroth, Fabled SOLDIER // Sephiroth, One-Winged Angel

720-1806-2034-6578.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Eternal Scourge, adidng {C}{C}.
When Eternal Scourge dies, Kinzu of the Bleak Coven and Sephiroth trigger.
Resolve the Sephiroth trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life
Resolve the Kinzu of the Bleak Coven trigger, causing you to pay 2 life and exile Eternal Scourge from your graveyard to create a token copy of it that is 1/1.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Eternal Scourge token, adding {C}{C}.
When the Eternal Scourge token dies, Sephiroth triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life
Cast Eternal Scourge from exile by paying {3}.
Repeat.

874-2866-4247-4986.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one creature.
874-2866-4247-4986.description:
Cast Delif's Cone by paying its mana cost.
Teshar triggers, returning Scrap Trawler from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Delif's Cone by tapping and sacrificing it.
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing Scrap Trawler.
When Scrap Trawler dies, it triggers, returning Delif's Cone from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability.
Repeat.

3147-5686-6871-7115--44.description:
Cast the artifact by paying {0}.
Toph, Hardheaded Teacher triggers, earthbending Azorius Chancery.
Resolve the artifact spell.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Azorius Chancery.
When Azorius Chancery dies, Toph, Hardheaded Teach triggers, returning Azorius Chancery from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Azorius Chancery enters, it triggers, returning the artifact cast in step 1 from the battlefield to your hand, as it's a land due to Toph, the First Metalbender.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to either Kelpie Guide or Forensic Researcher

2085-5475-7786.description:
Activate Kelpie Guide by tapping it, targeting Forensic Researcher.
If Kelpie Guide has Hawkeye's Bow attached to it, Hawkeye's Bow triggers, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Resolve the Kelpie Guide ability, untapping Forensic Researcher.
Activate Forensic Researcher by tapping it, targeting Kelpie Guide.
If Forensic Researcher has Hawkeye's Bow attached to it, Hawkeye's Bow triggers, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Resolve the Forensic Researcher ability, untapping Kelpie Guide.
Repeat.

2447-3259-4885.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
2447-3259-4885.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Infestation Expert // Infested Werewolf as attackers.
Infestation Expert // Infested Werewolf triggers, creating at least one creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

uses.n: Yarus, Roar of the Old Gods

3259-5434-7605.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
3259-5434-7605.description:
Cast Indulge by paying {2}{R}.
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached as an attacker. Indulge triggers, creating a 1/1 Citizen creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the Citizen token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.
3259-5434-7605.notes: Afterwards, you can cast Excess from your graveyard for {1}{R} to create Treasures.

4681-5170-5686-7452.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Karmic Guide.
When Karmic Guide dies, Cauldron of Essence triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it and Cauldron of Essence trigger.
Resolve the Cauldron of Essence trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Karmic Guide from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Karmic Guide enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Repeat.

333-4050-7424.notablePrerequisites: Changing Loyalty attached to Shepherd of the Cosmos.
333-4050-7424.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Shepherd of the Cosmos.
When Shepherd of the Cosmos dies, Changing Loyalty triggers, returning Shepherd of the Cosmos from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Shepherd of the Cosmos enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Changing Loyalty from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Shepherd of the Cosmos.
Repeat.

710-3967-7424.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Danitha
When Danitha dies, Changing Loyalty triggers, returning Danitha from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Danitha enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Changing Loyalty from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Danitha.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat.

2438-5687-7084.easyPrerequisites:
You control a land.
You control another nonland creature.
2438-5687-7084.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing another nonland creature.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land you control.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing the earthbent land.
When the land dies, Skittering Precursor and Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger.
Resolve the Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Skittering Precursor trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat.
2438-5687-7084.notes: You can instead sacrifice the creature tokens to their own abilities instead of sacrificing them to Carrion Feeder.

3459-4316-5078-6723.description:
Activate Battered Golem by tapping it, adding {1}.
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Battered Golem triggers, untapping Battered Golem.
Repeat.

2750-6871-7033.description:
Cause Bumi to become an artifact using Memnarch.
Deal combat damage to an opponent. Bumi triggers, untapping all lands you control, including Bumi as it's a land due to Toph, and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat step 2 each combat phase.

2511-6132-6981.description:
Cast Perigee Beckoner for its warp cost by paying {1}{B}.
When Perigee Beckoner enters, it triggers, targeting Metamorphosis Fanatic.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Perigee Beckoner.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Metamorphosis Fanatic.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic dies, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic enters, it triggers, returning Perigee Beckoner from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Perigee Beckoner enters, it triggers, targeting Metamorphosis Fanatic.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability from step 4.
Repeat from step 3.

618-3967-6966.description:
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of All-Fates Stalker.
When the All-Fates Stalker token enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Kiki-Jiki until All-Fates Stalker leaves the battlefield.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing the All-Fates Stalker token.
When the All-Fates Stalker token dies, Kiki-Jiki is returned from exile to the battlefield.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat.

2279-3705-4050-6896.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Squee, adding {R}.
Cast Squee from your graveyard by paying {R}{R} due to Green Goblin.
Quintorius triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing Squee and the creature token, adding {R}{R}.
Repeat from step 2.

3670-4522-5346-6891.easyPrerequisites: A permanent you control has a removable quest counter on it.
3670-4522-5346-6891.description:
Activate Duchess by paying {1} and removing a quest counter from a permanent you control, creating a Junk token.
When the Junk enters, Ingenious Artillerist triggers, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Quest for Pure Flame triggers, putting a quest counter on it.
Activate the Junk by tapping and sacrificing it.
Crime Novelist triggers, adding {R} and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Junk's ability, exiling the top card of your library with the ability to play it until end of turn.
Repeat.

132-1995-4306.notablePrerequisites: Your devotion to white is at least four.
132-1995-4306.description:
Activate Myr Welder using Nyx Lotus's ability by tapping it, adding at least {W}{W}{W}{W}.
Activate Myr Welder by paying {2}{W}, untapping it.
Repeat.

560-2457-3000-5794.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating a 1/1 Insect, a 1/1 Soldier and two 1/1 Squirrel creature tokens.
Activate Baylen's first ability twice by tapping the Soldier, Insect and Squirrel tokens, adding {1}{G}.
Repeat.

6753-6785.easyPrerequisites: You have another way to create a token.
6753-6785.description:
Cast Devastating Onslaught by paying {6}{R}, creating six token copies of Exalted Sunborn.
Whenever you create one or more tokens until the beginning of your end step, you will instead create 128 times as many of those tokens due to the Exalted Sunborns.
6753-6785.notes: Paying {6}{R} to cast Devastating Onslaught is a minimum recommendation. The more mana you can pay, the more tokens you'll generate. For every {2} additional you pay, you'll create two extra Exalted Sunborn tokens, which will result in 4x more tokens.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with a +1/+1 counter on it and has lifelink

247-3693-4613.description:
Activate Twinblade Paladin by using Walking Ballista's ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to any target and causing you to gain 1 life due to its lifelink.
Twinblade Paladin triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

413-645-1267-5361.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
Alesha does not have summoning sickness.
413-645-1267-5361.description:
Declare Alesha as an attacker.
Alesha triggers, causing you to pay {U/B}{U/B} to return Auton Soldier from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped and attacking as a nonlegendary copy of Medomai the Ageless.
When Auton Soldier enters the battlefield, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Deal combat damage using Auton Soldier.
Auton Soldier triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Auton Soldier
Repeat each turn.

1750-1979-2104-5261.notablePrerequisites: Efreet Flamepainter does not have summoning sickness and cannot be blocked by an opponent.
1750-1979-2104-5261.description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Efreet Flamepainter.
Efreet Flamepainter triggers, causing you to cast Temporal Manipulation from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Temporal Manipulation, causing you to take an extra turn after this one and exile it.
Activate Isochron Scepter by paying {2} and tapping it, casting a copy of Pull from Eternity without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Pull from Eternity, putting Temporal Manipulation from exile into your graveyard.
Repeat each turn.

575-2099-4319-5441.notablePrerequisites: Skirk Alarmist does not have summoning sickness.
575-2099-4319-5441.description:
Activate Sarcatog's second ability by sacrificing Granite Witness.
When Granite Witness dies, Yedora triggers, returning Granite Witness from your graveyard to the battlefield face-down as a Forest land.
Resolve the Sarcatog ability, giving it +1/+1 until end of turn.
Activate Granite Witness by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Skirk Alarmist by tapping it, turning Granite Witness face-up.
Granite Witness triggers, untapping Skirk Alarmist.
Repeat.

2933-3129-4013.description:
Activate Eldrazi Displacer by paying {2}{C}, blinking Drowner of Hope.
When Drowner of Hope enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating four 1/1 Eldrazi Scion creature tokens.
Activate three Eldrazi Scions by sacrificing them, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Repeat.

342-1185-4186-4321-4384.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one Food.
Prize Pig does not have summoning sickness.
342-1185-4186-4321-4384.description:
Activate Prize Pig by tapping it, adding {1}.
Activate a Food you control by paying {1}, tapping and sacrificing it, causing you to gain 3 life.
Treebeard's second ability and Prize Pig trigger.
Resolve the Prize Pig trigger, putting three ribbon counters on it, then removing all ribbon counters from it and untapping it.
Resolve the Treebeard trigger, putting three +1/+1 counters on Scurry Oak.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token and a Food artifact token.
Repeat.

2092-4131-5089.notablePrerequisites:
Basalt Monolith does not have summoning sickness.
Agatha of the Vile Cauldron has power 1 or greater.
2092-4131-5089.description:
Activate Karn's first loyalty ability by putting a loyalty counter on it, causing Basalt Monolith to become a 3/3 artifact creature until end of turn.
Activate Basalt Monolith's first ability by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
activate Basalt Monolith's second ability by paying at most {2}, untapping it.
Repeat from step 2.

533-776-1329-5034.notablePrerequisites: Emry does not have summoning sickness.
533-776-1329-5034.description:
Activate Sol Ring by tapping it, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Makeshift Munitions by paying {1} and sacrificing Sol Ring, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Activate Emry by tapping it, allowing you to cast Sol Ring from your graveyard this turn.
Cast Sol Ring from your graveyard by paying {1}.
Jeskai Ascendancy's first and second abilities trigger.
Resolve the first trigger, causing creatures you control to get +1/+1 until end of turn and untapping all creatures you control.
Resolve the second trigger, allowing you to loot.
Repeat.

565-2909-3908.notablePrerequisites:
You control an Island that enters the battlefield untapped.
{6} plus six
565-2909-3908.description:
Cast Mind Games with buyback by paying {2}{U}{U}, targeting Spark Double.
Orvar triggers, creating a token copy of Spark Double that enters the battlefield as a nonlegendary token copy of Orvar.
Resolve Mind Games, returning it to your hand.
Cast Mind Games with buyback by paying {2}{U}{U}, targeting Spark Double.
Orvar and the Spark Double token trigger, creating two token copies of Spark Double that enters the battlefield as a nonlegendary token copy of Orvar.
Resolve Mind Games, returning it to your hand.
Cast Mind Games with buyback by paying {2}{U}{U}, targeting any Island that enters the battlefield untapped.
Orvar, Spark Double and the three Spark Double tokens trigger, creating five token copies of the Island.
Resolve Mind Games, returning it to your hand.
Activate four of the Island tokens by tapping them, adding {U}{U}{U}{U}.
Repeat from step 7.
Once you have infinite mana, you can then target any artifact, creature or land using Mind Games to get infinite tokens of them.

15-643-1339-5147.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to draw a card.
15-643-1339-5147.description:
Draw a card.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing the Insect.
Laid to Rest triggers, causing you to draw a card.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat from step 3.
